items.Sentence: The headworks include a rotary hydroscreen system, a screenings washer, and a metering flume.
an aeration pond (also known as the South Pond)...the third cell contains a 3-horsepower aerator, set on a timer, to create aerobic and anoxic conditions within the pond.
The settling pond (also known as the North Pond) is used for storage during high flows and for filter backwashes.
Biosolids generated during the treatment process accumulate in the aeration and settling ponds, where they undergo anaerobic digestion and densification.
The cleaned and dewatered solids are disposed of at a landfill.

Tertiary treatment is achieved in the microfiltration system.
To maintain cleanliness in the filters, the secondary effluent is pre-chlorinated using sodium hypochlorite prior to filtration; the chlorinated effluent ... is dechlorinated using sodium bisulfite.

Treated wastewater is discharged to an approximately 3.25-million-gallon effluent storage pond used for storage of advanced treated wastewater prior to discharge to Jones Creek or the recycled water system.
Treated wastewater from the 3.25-million-gallon effluent storage pond is recycled for urban and agricultural irrigation, including frost control on vineyards (Discharge Point 003).
During the 2012 biosolids removal event, approximately 99 dry tons of solids were removed from the ponds and land applied by Synagro Technologies, Inc.
